purpose: Remove the split between rhythm skill definitions and stock battle recipes without inventing gameplay semantics or allowing double resource spend.

recommended_architecture.secondary_wallet_rule: UMelodiaTokenWalletSubsystem_mana_is_separate_and_must_be_explicitly_declared_by_a_content_definition; it is never implicitly charged by battle skill execution
recommended_architecture.reason: The stock battle execution path already resolves FMelodiaSongSkillRecipe, while the project module cannot be imported by MelodiaCore. A plugin-owned definition can serve both paths without a reverse module dependency.

current_split.unsafe_shortcut: copying or partially projecting one struct into the other at subsystem startup

request_protocol.request_id: stable FGuid per battle command; replay of an accepted id returns the original result and never spends again
request_protocol.submit: UMelodiaBattleSession validates phase, target, cooldown, and skill-point availability before starting rhythm presentation
request_protocol.grade: UMelodiaRhythmCombatSubsystem owns timing and produces one typed result for the request id
request_protocol.resolve: UMelodiaBattleSession consumes the typed result, spends skill points exactly once, and invokes stock effect resolution
request_protocol.cancel: interrupted, invalidated, or reset request has no spend and no pending effect
request_protocol.blueprint_rule: BP_MelodiaSkill_Base may request, present, and react to the result; it may not spend resources or apply effects

migration_sequence: Add the plugin-owned canonical definition and preserve stable SkillId values.
Add an explicit loader/bridge that maps every canonical field, with fail-closed validation for missing pattern, effect, target, or cost data.
Refactor UMelodiaRhythmCombatSubsystem and UMelodiaRhythmExecutionComponent to consume the canonical definition.
Move battle-session lookup and stock execution to the same canonical definition path.
Remove implicit TrySpendMana from battle skill completion unless a definition explicitly declares a separate mana cost.
Add request-id, cooldown, cost-result, duplicate, cancel, and reset tests before authoring BP_MelodiaSkill_Base.
Promote the first Skill fixture only after live compile, map, PIE, failure, and idempotency evidence.
forbidden_until_complete: guessed cache adapter from UMelodiaRhythmSkillDefinition into FMelodiaSongSkillRecipe
duplicated SkillId definitions with independently authored costs
implicit double charge to combat skill points and token-wallet mana
Blueprint-owned damage, healing, SP, mana, cooldown, or save mutation
offline_validation_invariants: canonical definition class is plugin-owned and does not duplicate the current game-module class name
every direct identity mapping is present exactly once
EffectType, Element, Niche, CooldownPolicy, and ManaCost are not silently coerced into one another
ChartNotes use authored lanes in the inclusive range 0..3 and positive durations
legacy pitch/duration arrays are accepted only as a matched-length fallback
one explicit skill-point cost source exists and mana is never charged implicitly
request-id replay, cancellation, and reset semantics remain declared
acceptance_evidence: one SkillId resolves to one canonical definition in both battle and rhythm paths
one accepted request has one request id, one cost result, one pending effect, and one stock resolution
cancel and reset leave no resource or pending-effect side effect
offline schema validator and native unit tests pass
live BP fixture remains L1 until compile/map/PIE evidence exists
